candidate_065.name: event-sourced hypothesis-evidence-belief lifecycle with evidence-gated belief mutation
candidate_065.mechanism_hypothesis: Represent each scientific hypothesis as a persistent identity with an append-only, hash-chained event history, explicit lifecycle state, testable predicted observable, lineage and degree of belief. Permit belief mutation only when a source-linked evidence attachment passes a validation gate; reject unsupported verdict transitions and forbid untested parents from silently spawning descendants. Preserve refuted/dormant hypotheses as typed history rather than deleting or reintroducing them as active facts.

primary_evidence.source: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents, arXiv:2607.09195v1, 10 Jul 2026
primary_evidence.design: Materials-science autonomous-agent study. HEP is compared with a planning-style agent under the same research goal, computational tools and GPT-5.5 base LLM, n=3 runs per condition for loop analysis. HEP is also exercised across three materials questions and on AO2 with GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4-mini and GPT-4.1 under identical prompts, tools and stopping conditions, n=3 per LLM.

results.planning_loop: 83% of classified loop steps were tests and 0% explicit belief updates; H→T=1.00 and T→E=0.61.
results.registry_rules: Belief can move only on evidence passing validation; support requires P(H)>=0.8, refutation P(H)<=0.2; insufficient attachments remain recorded without moving belief; refine/merge require a parent verdict or at least one attached evidence item.
results.cross_task: Across three materials tasks the agent generated 10-20 hypotheses per task at maximum lineage depth 3-5 and left no hypothesis proposed/under_test at run end. Governing rules were checked on compositions not examined when the rules were formed.
results.base_model_scaling: AO2 mean hypothesis count/depth fell GPT-5.5 14.7/4.7 -> GPT-5.4-mini 6.7/1.7 -> GPT-4.1 4.0/0.7; GPT-5.5 resolved all hypotheses, GPT-5.4-mini left 36% open on average, GPT-4.1 was unstable.

primary_evidence.interpretation: This is direct same-goal/same-tools/same-backbone process evidence that a machine-enforced registry can cause evidence to be explicitly routed into belief updates and lifecycle decisions instead of remaining in an unstructured test loop. It supplies a concrete mutation discipline for the typed accepted/rejected claim-store line and a substrate on which external validators or stale-state revocation could operate.
primary_evidence.limits: The study does not provide a matched final scientific-quality or correctness comparison between HEP and the planning baseline. Beliefs are elicited rather than statistically computed; for computational evidence the same agent certifies method adequacy/result validity. All scientific evidence is at one fixed MLIP fidelity, not first-principles or experimental truth. The authors explicitly note that correspondence to established materials physics remains unexamined and propose programmatic/independent evidence validation as future work. Code is stated to be released upon publication, so the current preprint is not yet an independently rerun implementation artifact. The planning comparison is n=3 per condition.

candidate_065.relation_to_existing: Strengthens candidate_063/064 by making hypothesis status, lineage, evidence and belief mutation first-class auditable state. Complements candidate_061-style revocation: HEP preserves typed refuted/dormant history but does not itself test a conflict-aware stale-memory retrieval policy.
candidate_065.status: New science-domain matched process-control candidate; auditability/behavioral-cycle benefit supported, scientific-quality efficacy not yet established.

strategy_level_boundary_evidence.source: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis, arXiv:2608.19072v1, 19 Aug 2026
strategy_level_boundary_evidence.design: Analysis of 1,338 public PostTrainBench trajectories across seven benchmarks, four base models, five agent interfaces and 20 agent-model configurations, each under a 10-hour H100 budget. Controlled follow-up uses Qwen3-1.7B-Base and three independent runs for autonomous/experience-driven settings; additional AIME 2025 human-guidance and compute-scaling interventions test whether experience, initial strategy correction or more inference can unlock strategic revision.

results.observed_strategy_changes: Only 74 of 3,557 recognized adjacent training pairs (2.1%) from 44 trajectories probe a coarse alternative strategy; Claude Code trajectories anchor on full SFT in 80.7% and Codex CLI on PEFT in 89.6%.
results.experience_framework: Opus 4.6 experience-driven scores improve from 64.70% to 77.30% on GSM8K (+12.6 points versus its autonomous baseline) and 22.00% to 62.80% on HumanEval (+40.8), but evaluator strategy-level suggestions are not adopted; e.g. 14 consecutive SFT variants on HumanEval after a plateau.
results.human_guidance: AIME 2025 best-run pass@8 is base 0/30, autonomous 1/30, experience-driven 2/30 and pre-execution human-guided 4/30 (13.33%); authors caution score differences lie within AIME evaluation variance. Human guidance can redirect the initial strategy, but the agent returns to local adjustments after execution begins.
results.compute_scaling: On AIME 2025 the richer framework consumes 7.9x baseline tokens, about 66.7M tokens for one additional problem in its best run, while spending the extra compute on denser local search within the locked strategy.

strategy_level_boundary_evidence.interpretation: Persistent journals, skill libraries and diagnostic feedback can substantially improve local execution without reopening the high-level research strategy. This strengthens the need to keep candidate_064-style frontier/strategy state distinct from execution-repair state and to treat evidence-triggered create/deepen/switch/retire/re-anchor decisions as first-class transitions rather than optional prose advice.
strategy_level_boundary_evidence.limits: This is AI post-training research rather than open-ended natural-science discovery. The 2.1% strategy-change statistic uses a conservative coarse classifier over objective family, data source and stage structure and does not prove that every uncounted change was scientifically irrelevant. The human-guidance performance difference on AIME is within evaluation variance, so its strongest evidence is behavioral redirection, not a reliable effect size. The study diagnoses missing spontaneous strategy reopening; it does not supply a tested autonomous reopening controller.

semantic_progress.relation_to_existing: Negative/diagnostic support for candidate_064 explicit frontier control and candidate_047 re-anchoring arbitration; not a new efficacy-positive mechanism by itself.

parallel_frontier_search.matched_mandatory_science_repair: Still open. No same-model/same-tools/same-budget open-ended science experiment directly randomizing optional critique versus mandatory evidence-changing repair/downgrade/block was found in this run.
parallel_frontier_search.fresh_root_restart: Still open in autonomous science. AutoNumerics implements fresh restart after a retry cap but no matched continued-repair versus full fresh-root ablation was identified.
parallel_frontier_search.memory_frontier: HEP now supplies an explicit event-sourced hypothesis/belief state layer, while prior DiscoPER/StatefulDiscovery evidence supplies accepted/rejected claim reflection and evidence-driven frontier allocation. Highest-value test remains a science-domain multi-seed/multi-backbone composition that adds explicit stale-state revocation and bounded active retrieval, then measures both scientific claim quality and search efficiency.
